_what: Trimmed fragments of REAL cached fragrance PDPs, for tests/test_spec_spine_d2.py (M7 UNIT D2, the spec spine). Each file is: the page's own <title>, its og:title/og:description/og:url meta tags, and the ONE JSON-LD <script> block carrying a Product node WITH a description — all copied byte-for-byte out of the cached page. Everything else (nav, offers markup outside that block, scripts, body) is dropped. Nothing is added, rewritten or invented: no note list, concentration, scent family or size below was authored here.
_why_these_three: us_fragrancex + us_perfume_com are the SAME fragrance (Christian Dior 'Sauvage Cologne') captured from two different retailers, so the seeder's group-by-normalised-identity step has a real two-page group to collapse. ae_tuzzut is a third, unrelated fragrance so a passing grouping test cannot be an artefact of everything landing in one bucket.
_no_network: Every byte here came off disk. NOTHING in this unit fetched fragrantica.com, parfumo.com, Serper or OpenAI (house rule 7).

us_fragrancex_com_dior_sauvage_cologne.h.kept: <title>, the og:title/og:description meta tags, and JSON-LD block #3 verbatim (the Product node: name 'Sauvage Cologne', brand 'Christian Dior', and a 1327-char description whose prose states the fragrance family 'Aromatic Fougere' and the top/heart/base note lists).
us_fragrancex_com_dior_sauvage_cologne.h.used_by: TestSeederDryRun — one of the two pages that must collapse into a single spine candidate.

us_perfume_com_dior_sauvage_cologne.html.kept: <title>, the og:title/og:description meta tags, and JSON-LD block #2 verbatim (the Product node: name 'Sauvage Cologne', brand 'Christian Dior', and a 2121-char description whose prose states 'Fragrance Family: Fresh, Woody' and explicit Top/Middle/Base note lists).
us_perfume_com_dior_sauvage_cologne.html.used_by: TestSeederDryRun — the SECOND page of the same fragrance. Its retailer title differs from FragranceX's, so a passing test shows the normalised identity key (not the raw title) is what groups them.

ae_tuzzut_com_maison_alhambra_sceptre_ma.kept: <title>, the og:title/og:description meta tags, and JSON-LD block #0 verbatim (the Product node: name 'Sceptre Malachite Maison Alhambra - 100ml', brand 'Maison Alhambra', and a description whose prose states 'Oriental Woody', the top/middle/base note lists and 'Eau De Parfum').
ae_tuzzut_com_maison_alhambra_sceptre_ma.used_by: TestSeederDryRun — the third, DISTINCT fragrance: it must land in its own spine candidate.
